text: The paper reports that ranking the most relevant paragraphs and generating from them (the same Rank and Answer step used for classification) raises placebo description accuracy over the Elicit baseline from 25% to 65% correct (p = 0.025).
title: Placebo description accuracy improves from 25% to 65% with rank-and-answer
